caps.theme_cap: any rule in the theme rated 4 -> theme at least 3

combine.worst: Each document / Document level: rating = max over the roles the rule ran on.
combine.best: Product pack: rating = min over the roles (requirement needs to appear once).
combine.best_terms_then_worse_of_advert: Product pack with an advert: min over terms roles, then max with the advert rating if the advert was assessed.

aggregation.theme: mean of rule ratings in the theme, banded, theme cap applied
aggregation.product: mean of theme ratings (equal weight), banded, graded caps applied

applicability.islamic_only_rules: N/A unless the card is Islamic
applicability.role_absent_by_design: N/A when every role the rule runs on is marked NA for the card (e.g. card has no rewards programme)
applicability.role_expected_but_missing: 'Not assessed: document missing' and counts against coverage
applicability.scored_under: secondary rule of a repository overlap is not scored; its parent is

required_if_detected.REWARDS: card advertises cashback, points or miles

contradiction_flag: When a best-of rule is satisfied in one terms document but another terms document has an explicit clause that fails it (e.g. 60-day notice in general T&C vs "without any intimation" in rewards terms), show a Contradiction flag on the rule for examiner review. Display only in v1.
themes: Advertising and value proposition vs terms
Card security, fraud and unauthorised transactions
complaints: Display only: volume and type per theme next to the theme rating; "Corroborated" when theme >= 3 and complaints above peer median. Never changes the score.
